key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.8s): Initial archival pose of flower; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.92s): Mid-sequence articulation of flower; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=5.16s): Peak dynamic extension of flower over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=6.4s): Follow-through and settle of flower with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of flower (2.8s..6.4s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
